blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The first elected Bangsamoro Parliament convened in the regional legislature’s plenary hall at the Bangsamoro Government Center here on Friday with 79 of 80 members present. Sheikh Muslim Guiamaden, Bangsamoro wali or ceremonial head, struck the gong, which symbolizes the opening of the session. Director Jaime Ayub, the highest-ranking officer of the Secretariat from the Interim Parliament, then presided over the election of a temporary presiding officer so the body could proceed to business. Member of Parliament (MP) Naguib Sinarimbo then nominated MP Ishak Mastura as the temporary presiding officer, and members seconded the motion. READ: Bangsamoro starts […]...
